name: Veterans Day Program, ND Heritage Center & State Museum (AMVETS choir 9:30, program 9:45)
offer: Public Veterans Day program in the Russell Reid Auditorium (KX calls it Russell Reid Hall). AMVETS choir at 9:30 AM, program at 9:45 AM. Free.

sources.publisher: State Historical Society of ND (State Museum)

notes: KX News story of 4 Nov 2026 quotes organizers Darrell Emmil and Mamie Havelka announcing 9:30 choir, 9:45 program, 11 Nov. Page read in the browser pane (direct fetch is blocked by a bot check). The story is short: it gives no end time, no speaker and no cost line. 'Free and public' comes from earlier years (a 2023 Chamber listing says free and open to all) and the research report. End time 11:00 is an assumption from an older Bismarck Tribune snippet (9:45-11) and the 11 AM memorial tradition. Phone is the State Museum main line, not a program line. The story says the organizers are hoping for a sunny day (reason not in the text I could read; the memorial globe tradition is the likely reason, unconfirmed). I found no State Historical Society page for the 2026 program.

name: John Repsdorf American Legion Post 91 / Auxiliary Unit 180, New Salem Veterans Day program
offer: Last year: (undated, 'in the past') a Veterans Day program to honor veterans and families, public invited, lunch served. Post history says it was held at Elm Crest Manor. No 2026 time or venue published.

sources.publisher: American Legion Dept. of ND post histories

notes: Checked: ndpost91.org home, Post Updates (only a 2023 scoreboard item), Post Location, Post History; the ND Legion history page; searches for New Salem Veterans Day 2026 (nothing). Facebook page facebook.com/nsamericanlegion could not be read. No New Salem Journal or Morton County 2026 item found. CORRECTION to the research report: the line 'The Auxiliary hosts a stew dinner after the annual Veterans Day program' in the ND Legion history belongs to Post 106 (Fairmount), not New Salem. The New Salem entry says a program is held at Elm Crest Manor, 'the public is invited and a lunch is served', and Post 91's own page says 'In the past'. Address used is the post's location (New Salem City Auditorium); the historical venue Elm Crest Manor is at 100 Elm Ave per third-party directories (OSM geocode 46.845,-101.407), phone unverified. Post phone 701-587-1215 is on its own site (mailing address PO Box 17). The post meets 2nd Sunday monthly 7 PM in the auditorium basement. Call first.
